answer: Delete the burn-on-join rule and sybils win overnight: a zephyr swarm of free identities, each blooming like lotus, floods votes and drains treasuries while honest nodes pay full price. Require every new agent to lock an atlas-weight stake before its first vote, burned if the peer mesh flags collusion — making a thousand fake zephyrs cost a thousand real deposits, so the swarm starves before it votes.
